label: input i late in the original phase, after d/m, in s-initial sequences
explanation: Very sparse conjunctive feature (95 of 6.5M dev steps). It fires almost only in the original phase (98% of mass), never in the copy phase, with a few weak hits on <DEL>. 85% of mass is on input i at orig_idx 5-7 (t=6 is the peak), mostly 0-2 tokens before <DEL>. Among those i steps, activation is much more likely and stronger when d or m was one or two steps earlier and when the sequence starts with s. The top example is s e 2 k d x [i]. Even so, the full conjunction only gets about 0.23 precision and 0.26 recall on dev. Input i late in the original phase alone covers 0.85 of mass but has precision 0.003, so the gating context is only partly captured. It does not fire on i at early positions (orig_idx < 4), on other tokens (except rare weak hits), or during copying.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 32 cues. Raise it: orig0=s (+3.36), prev_tok=d (+2.56), orig2=2 (+2.46), prev_tok=m (+2.38), orig2=h (+1.89), phase=0 & in_tok=i (+1.87). Lower it: phase=2 (-1.97), prev3_tok=- (-1.46), orig6=- (-0.97), in_count=1 (-0.70).
